motivation: The post-hoc adopted-bridge preservation floor improved historical-critical retention on the development replay, but the first unseen holdout (G11) did not activate the frozen production treatment. This second validation tests the already-frozen production rule on new natural trajectories without selecting tasks based on retention outcome.
primary_question: When the frozen adopted-bridge mechanism is naturally applicable on a previously unused task, does it change retention of historical-fix-adjacent evidence relative to an otherwise identical baseline replay?

candidate_pool.source: validated reverse-patch tasks already present in experiments/bridge_relevance/bridge_hard/exhaustive_discovery_results.json

eligibility: at least one natural shell rg/grep search output
before that search output the frozen 89da trajectory builder admits at least one bridge identifier from prior tool outputs
the current natural search query explicitly reuses at least one of those admitted bridge identifiers
the corresponding output reaches the production search relevance path
screen.selection: first eligible task in the frozen deterministic ordering
forbidden_during_selection: whether the preservation floor would rescue a record
fix-adjacent oracle overlap inside the target search output
comparison of baseline and treatment retention
task replacement because of an undesirable valid result

treatment.after_first_eligible_off_task: run exactly one ON condition on the same locked reverse-patch snapshot

primary_mechanism_evaluation.data: first exact captured inbound search request/output on which adopted-bridge preservation activates

conditions.A: identical frozen production scoring and trajectory context, adopted preservation identifiers disabled
conditions.D: identical frozen production scoring and trajectory context, frozen adopted preservation identifiers enabled

stopping_rules: stop after the first eligible OFF task and its single ON condition
stop after 12 valid OFF screens if none is eligible
if ON does not reproduce treatment activation, stop and report inactive treatment
do not search for a replacement after observing ON outcome
do not alter production algorithm 89da based on this validation

allowed_claims.if_rescue_observed: unseen natural mechanism replication of the frozen adopted-bridge preservation rule
allowed_claims.if_activation_without_rescue: unseen natural activation without observed critical-retention improvement
allowed_claims.if_on_inactive: historical/OFF applicability did not reproduce under the fresh treatment trajectory
allowed_claims.if_no_eligible_task: natural applicability remained sparse in a capped second unseen screen
